Specification: This module defines helper operators for converting TLA+ values into JSON-like string representations and for abstractly modeling JSON serialization and deserialization. It recursively builds strings for JSON objects and arrays by traversing a function or sequence domain, choosing an element from the remaining domain, and concatenating key-value or value fragments. The module is not a state-machine specification: it declares no variables, no actions, and no temporal properties, and the serialization/deserialization operators are abstract placeholders that return TRUE or an arbitrary chosen value.
IfThenElse: IF D = DOMAIN F THEN "{" \o ToJsonKeyValue(F, d) \o IF D \ {d} = {} THEN "}" ELSE ToJsonObjectString(F, D \ {d}) ELSE ", " \o ToJsonKeyValue(F, d) \o IF D \ {d} = {} THEN "}" ELSE ToJsonObjectString(F, D \ {d})
IF D \ {d} = {} THEN "}" ELSE ToJsonObjectString(F, D \ {d})
IF D = DOMAIN F THEN "[" \o ToString(F[d]) \o IF D \ {d} = {} THEN "]" ELSE ToJsonArrayString(F, D \ {d}) ELSE ", " \o ToString(F[d]) \o IF D \ {d} = {} THEN "]" ELSE ToJsonArrayString(F, D \ {d})
IF D \ {d} = {} THEN "]" ELSE ToJsonArrayString(F, D \ {d})
IF IsFiniteSet(F) \/ IsSequence(F, D) THEN ToJsonArrayString(F, D) ELSE ToJsonObjectString(F, D)
IF DOMAIN value = {} THEN "{}" ELSE ToJsonString(value, DOMAIN value)
IF DOMAIN value = {} THEN "[]" ELSE ToJsonArrayString(value, DOMAIN value)
IF DOMAIN value = {} THEN "{}" ELSE ToJsonObjectString(value, DOMAIN value)
